comments.body:
Yes. I’d skip the rubrics-review model run when there is nothing to score.

The linked example shows the current failure mode: `agent/rubrics` was absent, `RUBRICS_AVAILABLE=false`, and Sepo still spent a rubrics-review run to post an `N/A / 0 rubrics` comment. That is correct as a fallback, but it is not useful enough to justify a separate PR comment or model invocation during normal review.

Current shape:
- [`agent-review.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L247-L259) always calls the independent rubrics-review workflow.
- [`agent-rubrics-review.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.github/workflows/agent-rubrics-review.yml#L84-L141) resolves a provider and runs the agent before deciding whether the output is useful.
- [`download-agent-rubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.github/actions/download-agent-rubrics/action.yml#L126-L130) already cleanly reports `rubrics_available=false` for a missing branch.
- [`run-agent-task`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L309-L338) already selects rubrics before the model run, and [`selectRubrics`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.agent/src/rubrics.ts#L327-L357) can return zero selected rubrics.
- Docs already say rubrics review is an independent advisory lane and does not block normal review synthesis: [`rubrics.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/2bad84098072f6748bd5c7a4d9d3fce86d475ac6/.agent/docs/architecture/rubrics.md#L81-L90).

Proposed approach:
1. Add a lightweight preflight in `agent-rubrics-review.yml` before provider/runtime setup.
2. Use `download-agent-rubrics` with missing-branch continuation.
3. If the branch exists, run `rubrics/select.js --all-routes --limit all --best-effort` to count active rubrics available for scoring.
4. Skip provider setup, `run-agent-task`, artifact upload, and PR comment when either:
   - the rubrics branch is absent, or
   - selected active rubrics count is `0`.
5. Emit a workflow notice/summary explaining the skip, but do not post a PR comment from the normal review path.
6. Update docs/tests so this behavior is intentional and protected.

I’d keep `Agent / Rubrics / Initialization` unchanged: it is still the explicit path that bootstraps a missing `agent/rubrics` branch. Rubrics review should not bootstrap or invent rubrics.

No blockers on my side. Approve and I’d implement this as a small workflow/action test change.

---
